answer: Payments for graded work sit in escrow, and every claim a jury cannot verify cuts the payout by a fixed slice. Padding a submission costs money instead of earning it. One fake opal in the record voids that claim outright. The rest vests over later epochs, so a farm that abandons identities loses most of its balance. Crossing that canyon at full price is the entry fee for looking established, and no shortcut reaches the zenith without paying it.
